name: multi-company-portal
description: Multi-company login portal that hosts the FinTrack financial app per tenant, with master/staff accounts.
whatsNew: Redesigned the login page: a softly animated field of gold sparkles now drifts behind a glass card with the DRW shield, matching the gold-and-black look used across the rest of the app. Same sign-in form, same security behind it — just a new look.

Fixed a misleading login error: if too many people log in from the same network at once and Supabase's own protection kicks in, the login page used to say "incorrect password" — it now says there were too many attempts from your network and to wait a bit, which is what's actually happening.

Security hardening: the login page now pauses for 30 seconds after 5 failed attempts in a row, the database's public login-lookup can no longer be hammered indefinitely, and the site sends stricter browser security headers (blocks the page from being embedded elsewhere, blocks content-type sniffing tricks, and a content security policy limiting what can load).

Fixed the Provider page's "Link companies" checklist under each owner: the checkboxes were stretched and misaligned, and company logos weren't showing. Each row now shows the company's logo (or a placeholder) next to a properly-aligned checkbox and name.
